name: Retrieve CRC Port Usage
description: Retrieve CRC Port Usage Get CRC Port usage hour by hour for a specified time period We will report a maximum of one month. GET /v2/metrics/crc
context:
GET /v2/metrics/crc
Get CRC Port usage hour by hour for a specified time period We will report a maximum of one month. For example, if "from" is set to "2017-08-05" and "to" is "2017-10-10" we will adjust "from" to "2017-09-10" .
Required: from (query) — Start Date; to (query) — End Date

context:
